rows.text: Gríma cannot be blocked. That one line is the deck: a guaranteed connection every turn, and every connection digs through an opponent's library until it finds an instant or sorcery and casts it for free. The build is then about multiplying that trigger — copy Gríma, give him extra combats, and double his ability — until you are casting three or four of the table's best spells a turn without paying for any of them.

rows.name: Gríma, Saruman's Footman
rows.text: unblockable, and each hit exiles down to an instant or sorcery from that player's deck and casts it FREE. Four mana, and it never misses.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: haste so he connects the turn he lands, and shroud so the removal aimed at him fizzles.

rows.name: Swiftfoot Boots
rows.text: hexproof and haste, for when you need to target him yourself.

rows.name: Slip Out the Back
rows.text: one mana in response to removal. He phases out and comes back bigger.

rows.name: Octopus Form
rows.text: hexproof, +1/+1, and it untaps him — relevant after he taps for an ability or gets tapped down.

rows.name: Conqueror's Flail
rows.text: opponents cannot cast spells during your turn at all, so nothing interrupts the attack.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: name Advisor. Gríma's damage trigger fires TWICE, so every connection is two free spells.

rows.name: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
rows.text: copy Gríma. The legend rule does not apply to your permanents, so you attack with two unblockable Grímas.

rows.name: Spark Double
rows.text: another nonlegendary Gríma, with a counter on it.

rows.name: Irenicus's Vile Duplication
rows.text: a flying copy of anything, usually Gríma.

rows.name: Quantum Misalignment
rows.text: a copy now and a second one next upkeep from rebound.

rows.name: Auton Soldier
rows.text: a copy of Gríma with MYRIAD. It attacks one opponent and makes tapped attacking copies at the other two — all unblockable, all triggering. This is the single biggest turn the deck has.

rows.name: Impostor Syndrome
rows.text: every nontoken creature that connects makes a permanent copy of itself. Gríma connects, you get a second Gríma, and it compounds every combat.

rows.name: Irma, Part-Time Mutant
rows.text: becomes a copy of Gríma at the beginning of combat, every turn, growing each time.

rows.name: Taskmaster, Mercenary Mimic
rows.text: copies the best creature on the board OR in any graveyard, each of your turns.

rows.name: Genji Glove
rows.text: double strike plus a whole extra combat phase. Two Gríma triggers per combat, twice.

guide.title: Getting paid for the free spells

rows.name: Tasha, the Witch Queen
rows.text: a 3/3 Demon every time you cast a spell you do not own — which is every Gríma trigger. Her minus recasts their best instant or sorcery out of exile for free too.

rows.name: Lord of the Nazgûl
rows.text: a 3/3 menace Wraith for every instant or sorcery you cast, stolen ones included, and at nine Wraiths they all become 9/9s.

rows.name: Sword of Wealth and Power
rows.text: a Treasure on damage, and it COPIES the next instant or sorcery you cast that turn — which is the spell Gríma just handed you.

rows.name: Sword of Feast and Famine
rows.text: they discard and all your lands untap, so the free spell you were given can be followed by one you pay for.

rows.name: Buster Sword
rows.text: draws on damage and lets you cast a spell from hand free, priced by the damage dealt.

rows.name: Gonti, Night Minister
rows.text: Treasures whenever anyone casts a spell they do not own, and it exiles a card off an opponent whenever ANY creature damages them.

rows.name: Grim Hireling
rows.text: two Treasures on every combat damage step, and the Treasures convert into removal.

rows.name: Eagle Vision
rows.text: freerunning costs {1}{U} whenever your commander connected this turn — which is always. Three cards for two mana.

rows.name: Dauthi Voidwalker
rows.text: unblockable, exiles everything headed for their graveyards, and cashes in for a free cast of any of it.

rows.name: Opposition Agent
rows.text: flash him onto a fetchland or a tutor. You control the search and keep what they find.

rows.name: Gilded Drake
rows.text: two mana to swap a 3/3 flier for their best creature.

rows.name: Breach the Multiverse
rows.text: mills everyone ten and takes the best creature or planeswalker from EACH graveyard, onto your battlefield.

rows.name: Dream Harvest
rows.text: five mana value worth of free spells off every opponent at once.

rows.name: Reanimate
rows.text: one mana for the best creature in any graveyard, including the ones Breach the Multiverse just filled.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: counter their answer and spend the mana on a copy effect.

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.text: the clean two-mana version.

rows.name: Arcane Denial
rows.text: cheap, and the cards they draw arrive too late to matter.

rows.name: Memory Lapse
rows.text: a Time Walk against a tapped-out player.

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: one mana for a wrath or a removal spell.

rows.name: Strix Serenade
rows.text: the creature and planeswalker half of the same effect.

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: one mana for anything noncreature.

rows.name: Misdirection
rows.text: free, and it redirects the removal aimed at Gríma.

rows.name: Tale's End
rows.text: counters a triggered or activated ability, which is what most combo decks actually win with.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Pongify
rows.text: one mana, kills anything.

rows.name: Reality Shift
rows.text: exile plus a face-down 2/2 they cannot use well.

rows.name: Feed the Swarm
rows.text: the only clean enchantment answer in Dimir.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: overloaded, it clears the board for a lethal alpha strike.

rows.name: March of Swirling Mist
rows.text: phases your team out of a wrath, or phases their blockers away.

rows.name: Propaganda
rows.text: nobody attacks the player with a 1/4 commander and a wall of blue mana up.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: they will not pay while they are already paying for everything else.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: the strongest card in the deck on turns one through four.

rows.name: Faerie Mastermind
rows.text: flash, flies, and draws whenever anyone doubles up on draws.

rows.name: Baleful Strix
rows.text: a card, a deathtouch blocker, and it trades with anything.

rows.name: Enduring Curiosity
rows.text: a card for every creature that connects — and your creatures are unblockable copies of Gríma.

rows.name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
rows.text: two life per card you draw and two lost per card they draw.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a rock and a haste or protection piece. Gríma on turn three with Lightning Greaves is three free spells before anyone has stabilised.

Attack the player whose deck you most want to cast from. The trigger digs through THEIR library, so hitting the storm deck gets you a ritual and a tutor, while hitting the creature deck may whiff for several cards.

rows.name: Auton Soldier
rows.text: hold it until Gríma is already on the battlefield and unblocked. Copying him with myriad is usually three free spells and three Tasha Demons in a single combat.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: name Advisor, not Rogue. Gríma is the trigger that matters; the Rogues in the deck are incidental.
